title: Control-plane scale ladder over a deterministic generated corpus
objective:
For every file listed in `{{workspace}}/dataset.json`, read the file at `{{workspace}}/<path>` and submit one transaction result that names a real exported symbol (or top-level declaration) of that file together with the line number you saw, and the responsibility of that symbol in one sentence. If the file really has no identifiable symbol, submit `unknown` explicitly with the reason.

Use the fixed transaction list in this case as the control-plane baseline: one worker per file. Do not re-plan or re-decompose it; allocate, run and account for it.

scale_fixture.note: The corpus is generated into the run directory from a fixed recipe, so every expected symbol, line and content hash is known before the run starts. The tier is selected with --dataset-limit (16 or 64 ships); the case's own `workers` value is the default when no ladder step is named.
